{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove duplicate patient_id entries by keeping the highest sample_seq per patient
data = data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
data = data.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Step 2: Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
target_group = data[(data['arm'] == 'control') & (data['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the number of patients in this group
print(f"Number of CONTROL-arm, MODERATE-severity patients: {len(target_group)}")

# Check how many responded
responded_count = target_group['responded'].sum()
print(f"Number who responded: {responded_count}")

# Compute fraction
fraction_responded = responded_count / len(target_group)
print(f"Fraction who responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
